steps.content: Christina feels like she is back in good shape.
She runs all the way to the crime scene, only to see a large number of detectives and FAC personnel have sealed off the area, and the guy leading them is a familiar face.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Sigh, never mind. I can't stop you anyway.

Finally, the inspector waves his hand and lets her in. Christina has also made up her mind that this time she will not <color=#fb9259>resort to violence</color>, nor will she damage anything at the scene.

Eastside Third Avenue
Crime scene at Future Charity Foundation Park
Although Christina had a feeling when she heard their frightened reactions, she still felt a headache when it actually happened.

The incident at the Future Charity Foundation perfectly matches all of Shalom's concerns. The foundation is influential and difficult to control due to the large number of staff. If a scandal breaks out, it will greatly affect FAC's future operations.

The park has now been sealed off by FAC and the Eastside Public Security Bureau. The Future Charity Foundation, where the incident occurred, was on yesterday's warning list, and is one of the few organizations that scoffed at the warning. After all, their job is to operate and distribute FAC's compensation.

There is only one body at the scene, which has been sent for examination by the Public Security Bureau. Christina only got a report. According to the description in the report, the victim's flowers were forcibly removed and put in the vases at the scene.
